asr.full_text: The market is selling off right now. We were actually a little bit green earlier today. The S&P 500 was green. Bitcoin was nearing $79,000 once again, and all of a sudden, we just broke below $77,000 on Bitcoin. We have the S&P 500 down 1.2%, the NASDAQ down 1.6%. This is seemingly coming out of nowhere. I couldn't even find what was happening for about half an hour but yeah there is something that's going on it is directly tied to trump we'll talk about this the vix is jumping the volatility index oil is pumping so what's going on we'll talk about it if you don't mind hit subscribe so you can see future videos just like this also if you want to trade crypto just so we are seeing a bit of an rs flip or a sr flip so in bull markets we typically turn prior resistance into support but in bear markets we see the opposite and in my video yet yesterday i think it was i showed how in the previous bear market, um, we constantly saw like the previous support get turned into resistance. So I pointed that out yesterday, we were approaching this $80,000, which was support before, but it's also, um, the last couple of times that we've hit 70 on the daily our side, we've gotten rejected and that's technically overbought. We did that back when we hit 126,000. I believe the other time that we've seen it was when we went up to nearly 100,000 that got rejected back down. And we're basically there right now we're at like 68 or 70 on the RSI. We also see pumps into the Bitcoin conference constantly, which we're going into the Bitcoin conference constantly which we're going into the Bitcoin conference every single year if you see like a ten to thirty percent drop afterwards so yeah between all those things I did end up going short I could be wrong on it it's just a hedge a small hatch is a very small part of my portfolio but yeah we are seeing Bitcoin drop a bit today now if you do want to trade there's a link to ubit underneath the video You can get 100 usdt when you deposit 100 usdt on you But and right now the people that sign up to will get vip fees, which means that they're going to get 25 Um percent lower fees for the first month So check that out underneath the video It's in the link tree with the links to btcc and bigfi as well There are some different bonuses going on for both those. But yes, I did open up a small short trade. Keep in mind, it's just a bit of hedge because I still have a lot in the market. So yeah, it's going to be interesting. I do have some long positions on other exchanges still open, but I did flip short on this exchange. I really haven't shorted Bitcoin before, but everything lines up uh in a bear market year for us to go lower especially with what i was just talking about so yeah and what do you know we're going lower the nasdaq is down s p 500 is down oils up nearly five percent to 97 it's just spiking here um and the vix is up 7.14%. And this all happened very quickly. Like if you look back at 45 minutes ago. We were basically break-even for the day on the S&P 500. And then all of a sudden a 1% drop. So what's going on? Well reports say that Trump does not want to restart the war. But may see little alternative. So maybe a re-es escalation of the war, Trump is also scheduled to speak in about an hour from the time this recording, so maybe some announcement the markets now pricing and future escalation. And instead of, you know, this rosy picture of the future where iran and the u.s can just come out to some deal that's mutually beneficial it looks like we may see a re-escalation so the market's going back and forth israel apparently is also awaiting the u.s to greenlight the the war resuming so um yeah the market hates this, it hates uncertainty. There are stocks like, let's just look, Microsoft, one of the biggest companies in the S&P 500, down nearly 5%. Part of that is due to earnings from Now, which is another software company or a software as a service company that came in and are weak um weak guidance but yeah a lot of people are worried about this market and you can see it with companies like microsoft just continuously selling off this is kind of a double whammy since it's uh you know it's in the software space but like this is selling at a 23 ford price earnings ratio which is very low historically um so what am i doing i'm buying good companies like this like microsoft um a couple weeks ago three weeks ago whenever we're towards the bottom i was buying amazon at 200 less uh i haven't bought google in a while, but I bought meta sub 600 $550. I was buying meta, right. So as we can see here, like a lot of these names, even with a little bit today, they're up 20% in less than a month. So I wouldn't get too worried about this. You know, this re escalation, I think you just have to realize it's going to be back and forth. Even when we seem like we have some kind of end to the war, yeah, there's going to be some choppiness and we could have a re-escalation. Now, the great thing is, if you're someone that doesn't have to retire in the next year or two, you don't have to worry about the war, right, because eventually it'll be over. And yeah, it might affect company earnings a bit. But you're also getting companies a huge discount. I mean, Microsoft would top out at $580 and you can buy it for 410 today. Like the a lot of the underlying businesses are actually very strong still in the S&P 500. So I'm not worried uh because i'm being able to buy companies much cheaper than i would otherwise but i realize that some people still get worried and try to time the market perfectly and like even the lever training i'm doing right i'm not trying to time the market perfectly i mean it'd be great but i'm not i'm not going out using a hundred x thinking that i can get within a percent of the bottom or the top. No, like those are more fun active positions that are very small compared to like my actual crypto positions, my spot bags, and the positions I have in the stock market and then real estate. But yeah, the fact is the retail investor can make lots of money, even more than Wall Street long-term, because we don't have to worry about the day- day. You can buy in uncertainty and wait and wait and wait and wait and wait and wait and then eventually you'll come back and you do quite well. Now, I don't think this is a time to go like bottom feeding for the stocks that are down the most or cryptos that are down the most. I think you can just place your bets on the largest, best companies and the largest crypto in the world and continue to wait until we eventually rebound now we could go lower too right i'm not saying to go all in or anything like that i'm just dollar cost averaging i went really heavy about a month ago because the market was down so much and there were great tech names that were down significantly 20 30 so if we get down to that point again I will buy heavier but yeah right now I'm just dollar cross averaging and um let me know your thoughts on all this underneath the video if you want to trade crypto again check out the links underneath the video in the link tree I appreciate it I'll see y'all just a reminder this is not Financial advice this is not legal advice.
